items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19

ctx.x: Oh, some of these. Did you have your uncle John Robichaux in the Larrick's Theatre, did you play with him?

Yeah, well I played with him on a boat several times. Oh, it was on the lake. Yeah, on the lake, but Miss Margaret Kimball, she was a regular pianist in his band, and they had Kimball, the trumpet player, the wife and the husband playing in the band. So I played at her place, and he had a piano player once by the name of Buddy Christian, used to play for the moving pitches. I knew him, I knew him, he was in New York. Yeah, well I played at Buddy's place a lot of times for the movies, when my uncle played, when…
By the way, do you know if Buddy Christian is still living?
